milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player spawns inside a cobblestone structure with walls at ±4 blocks from spawn. The north wall at (0, 1, -4) is targeted. The player needs to be within 10 blocks and facing toward it (within 60°). Since the player spawns at origin inside the structure, they just need to turn toward the north wall. This rule type is preferred over position_inside_box for find tasks because it models 'player can see the target'.

Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind='block', max_count=3) because glass panes drop nothing when broken without Silk Touch, so inventory_has cannot detect the mining action. Instead, we verify that fewer than 4 panes remain in the bounding box that encompasses all 4 pane positions (east wall at x=4,y=1-2,z=0 and north wall at x=0,y=1-2,z=-4). The box [-5,0,-5] to [5,3,5] generously covers all pane locations. If max_count <= 3, at least 1 pane was broken.

Uses inventory_has because selling iron ingots to the armorer villager yields emeralds that appear in the player's inventory. The player starts with exactly 0 emeralds and 16 iron ingots. After completing one trade (4 iron ingots → 1 emerald), the player will have at least 1 emerald. Checking for min_count=1 emerald confirms a successful sale occurred. This is preferred over position-based rules because it directly verifies the trade outcome.

Uses inventory_has because trading with the shepherd villager for wool results in white_wool appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 wool of any color. After trading 1 emerald → 1 white_wool with the shepherd, the player will have at least 1 white_wool. This directly verifies the trade was completed successfully.
